param: β Transmission rate parameter (rate at which new infections take place given a contact) used in force of infection λ(t) ∝ β * (infectious prevalence). Paper assumes homogeneous mixing.
σ Daily progression rate through latent stages: E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁. Implies mean incubation/latent period d_L = 2*(1/σ). Treated as known from previous studies.
γ Daily progression rate through infectious stages: I₁→I₂ and I₂→R. Implies mean infectious period d_I = 2*(1/γ). Treated as known from previous studies.

λ(t) Force of infection at time t. Text: proportional to number of infectious people and constant transmission rate β. (Population scaling not specified in extracted text; homogeneous mixing assumed.)
π Initial susceptibility (fraction of population non-immune at start). Appears in parameter set Θ_T=(π, λ₀, ψ, σ, γ).
λ₀ Initial infection rate / initial force of infection parameter used in early exponential growth re-parameterization (EGR).
ψ Early exponential growth rate (EGR) parameter used to re-parameterize the transmission model under initial exponential growth assumption.
p_ICU Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection (severity measure).
μ_ICU|E Mean delay from infection/exposure to ICU/HDU admission; waiting time modeled as Gamma distributed. Treated as known from previous studies.
σ²_ICU|E Variance of delay from infection/exposure to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma waiting time). Treated as known from previous studies.
η Negative Binomial dispersion parameter for weekly ICU/HDU admission counts (observation model).
